claims.text: Increasing Al content above 15 at% promotes rapid formation of a continuous, adherent Al2O3 surface scale during high-temperature oxidation.
The Al2O3 scale together with high configurational entropy suppresses elemental interdiffusion.
The Al2O3 scale together with high configurational entropy suppresses grain coarsening.
Suppression of interdiffusion and grain coarsening enhances both structural and chemical stability.
Above approximately 15 at% Al, selective outward diffusion of Al occurs.
Rapid oxidation of outward-diffusing Al produces a continuous Al2O3 barrier.
A continuous Al2O3 barrier limits further oxygen ingress.
A continuous Al2O3 barrier limits further Al depletion.
High configurational entropy lowers chemical-potential gradients.
High configurational entropy slows atomic diffusion.
Entropy-related diffusion retardation suppresses phase separation.
At least 15 at% Al will yield a continuous Al2O3 scale no thicker than 1 micrometer after 100 h at 800 degrees Celsius in air.
At least 15 at% Al will result in less than 10% mass gain under the specified oxidation conditions.
At least 15 at% Al will result in less than 20% grain coarsening under the specified oxidation conditions.
Below 15 at% Al, the alloy will form patchy mixed Cr2O3 and Fe-oxide scales.
Below 15 at% Al, mass gain will exceed 30% under the specified oxidation conditions.
Below 15 at% Al, grain coarsening will exceed 50% under the specified oxidation conditions.
The prediction is valid for 10–30 at% Al at 700–900 degrees Celsius in oxidizing atmospheres.
The prediction does not apply under reducing atmospheres or cyclic oxidation.
The threshold Al concentration for continuous scale formation may vary by plus or minus 2 at%.

contradictions.description: The alloy is called equiatomic while Al is said to vary from 5 to 25 at%; a five-component Cr–Fe–Co–Ni–Al alloy is fully equiatomic only at 20 at% of each element unless 'equiatomic' refers only to the four non-Al elements.

The hypothesis specifies a critical condition of greater than 15 at% Al, whereas the prediction assigns the protective behavior to compositions greater than or equal to 15 at%, producing disagreement at exactly 15 at%.
The stated validity range begins at 10 at% Al, but the baseline and falsification control contain 5 at% Al. Thus the decisive comparison relies on a control outside the declared prediction boundary.
